def factor_drawdown_ewm(df):
    """Drawdown duration ratio using exponential weighting to emphasize recent drawdown observations. Stocks with fewer and more recently avoided drawdown days are favored."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    high = df_copy["high"]
    lookback_peak = 120
    lookback_count = 20
    peak_hist = high.rolling(lookback_peak, min_periods=lookback_peak).max().shift(1)
    peak_hist = peak_hist.fillna(method="ffill")
    in_drawdown = (close < peak_hist).astype(int)
    drawdown_ewm = in_drawdown.ewm(span=lookback_count, min_periods=lookback_count).mean()
    drawdown_signal = -drawdown_ewm
    df_copy["factor_drawdown_ewm"] = drawdown_signal
    return df_copy["factor_drawdown_ewm"]
description: Mutates parent drawdown duration factor by ablating the volume stability modifier and replacing simple rolling sum with exponential weighted mean (span=20) on the drawdown indicator. The ewm gives higher weight to recent observations, improving responsiveness. The core mechanism—favoring stocks with fewer drawdown days—is preserved. This simplification removes potential noise from volume modulation and targets improved IC and ICIR.
